message.reasoning_content: We need to compare two statements. Both are about "Regulamentação do trabalho de motoristas de aplicativo" (regulation of app drivers). Manifestation A: speaker opposes the government bill (project of law) presented, calls it absurd, wants total rejection. Manifestation B: speaker supports the PLP 12 (a specific bill) and says it advances, wants approval. Are they the same specific proposition? Manifestation A refers to "esse projeto de lei que o Governo apresentou" (the bill the government presented). Manifestation B refers to "Projeto de Lei Complementar nº 12" (PLP 12) and also mentions a proposal 536. The government bill could be PLP 12? Need to see if they are same. In A, they say "Esse projeto, Deputado, é muito parecido com a CLT... Nós não queremos CLT... queremos a rejeição total desse projeto." In B, they say "O PLP 12 veio com vários pontos... O PLP 12 avança... precisamos que o Governo e os nobres Deputados apoiem este projeto em vista do avanço que ele representa, para que nós possamos ter uma regulamentação aprovada nesta Casa com o PLP 12". So A is against the government bill; B is for PLP 12. Are they the same bill? Likely the government bill is PLP 12 (since it's a government proposal). But A says "o Governo apresentou" and calls it a failure, wants rejection. B says government set up GT, and PLP 12 is a step forward, supports it. Could be same proposition but opposite stance. However need to be certain they refer to same specific proposition. The texts: A mentions "projeto de lei que o Governo apresentou" but not number. B mentions "Projeto de Lei Complementar nº 12". Could be same. The theme same, date a month apart. Likely same bill. But we must decide based on text only. Since A doesn't name the bill, but describes it as "muito parecido com a CLT, mas sem os direitos... queremos rejeição total". B describes PLP 12 as advancing, wants approval. The descriptions differ: A says it's like CLT without rights; B says it brings rights, transparency, etc. Could be different bills. But both are government proposals on same theme. The classification requires "same specific proposition". Without explicit identification, uncertain. So relation uncertain. Could be INCOMPARABLE if they are different propositions. But we cannot be sure they are same. The safe category: RELATION_UNCERTAIN because comparability unclear. The stance determinable for each (A against, B for). But same proposition? Not clear. So RELATION_UNCERTAIN.
